captured_cases.expected_outcome: The authentic BTM Step 12 page opens.
The authentic Vivacom Step 10 scorecard opens.
The BTM roadmap paired with the real measurement payload refuses by name.

atomic_step.outcome: The open CLI freezes a complete, payload-grounded unit manifest for authentic page/payload pairs and refuses wrong pairings, non-repository work roots, and incompatible reopens.
atomic_step.practical_value: A critic cannot silently omit page territory or judge a page against unrelated stored material.
atomic_step.stopping_condition: All frozen cases pass through the assembled candidate and the promoted open CLI repeats them.

composition.assembly_contract: Use the selected unit enumerator unchanged as the critique open boundary.

final_validation.failure_criterion: Any case reports a different outcome or incomplete territory.
final_validation.operator_path: execute the selected critique.py against each frozen page/state archive
final_validation.success_criterion: Every real case reports its declared outcome with exact territory coverage on opened pages.

approaches.hypothesis: Stored record boundaries produce units closest to the objects a person can judge alone.
approaches.implementation: Enumerate top-level stored objects and list records, then assign rendered blocks by word overlap.
approaches.predicted_tradeoff: Strong payload identity with possible empty units when a stored record is omitted from this rendered page.

approaches.hypothesis: Rendered heading boundaries preserve the page's visible reading structure while payload binding supplies provenance.
approaches.implementation: Enumerate heading sections, then bind each section to its strongest stored record by word overlap.
approaches.predicted_tradeoff: Complete visible sections, but a long table under one heading may be too coarse to judge alone.

mini_probes.goal: Cut authentic delivered pages into complete, judgeable territories bound to stored payload records.
mini_probes.practical_value: A critic cannot silently omit page territory or judge a page against unrelated stored material.

proof.failure_criterion: Any expected outcome differs or any rendered block is omitted or multiply assigned.
proof.success_criterion: Both authentic pairs open, the mismatched pair refuses, and every rendered block is assigned exactly once.

winner_output.description: The tested page/payload identity guard and complete unit-cut implementation.

mini_probes.work_type_reason: Payload traversal, identity evidence, and exact territory accounting are deterministic code boundaries.
